card.line: The Valley of Eshcol was a valley in Canaan where Israel's spies cut a huge cluster of grapes, and it was named for that cluster.

moments.title: The giant cluster of grapes
moments.text: The spies cut a branch with a single cluster of grapes there. Two men carried it on a pole, and they also took pomegranates and figs. The place was named the Valley of Eshcol for the cluster.

moments.title: The report back to Israel
moments.text: After forty days the spies returned and showed the people the fruit. They said the land flowed with milk and honey, but the people were strong. Caleb said they could certainly conquer it.

moments.title: Remembered as a time of fear
moments.text: Moses later recalled that the spies came to Eshcol and saw the land. Their words discouraged Israel from entering, and the LORD's anger was kindled. That generation wandered forty years, except Caleb and Joshua.
